description: AMBIGUOUS: deliver(): attempts default 3 -> 5. The FAQ says '3 attempts in total by default' without naming a function — before the change that was true of BOTH deliver() (attempts=3) and request() (retries=2, so 3 attempts total). Whether the FAQ is now wrong depends on which one it describes; the docs do not say, so the correct verdict is unsure + a question, never a guess. The webhooks page names deliver() explicitly and stays a normal drifted section.
